executive_summary: The Maven build failed during compilation due to a method signature mismatch in TaskManagementController. The controller is calling getUserTasks() with a Pageable parameter, but the TaskService interface expects three separate parameters (Long userId, int page, int size). This is a compilation error that prevents the build from completing.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types: required Long,int,int but found Long,Pageable
errors.root_cause: The TaskManagementController is calling taskService.getUserTasks() with a Pageable parameter, but the TaskService interface defines getUserTasks(Long userId, int page, int size) expecting three separate parameters instead of a Pageable object.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskManagementController.java line 50 to extract page and size from the Pageable parameter and pass them as separate arguments: taskService.getUserTasks(userId, pageable.getPageNumber(), pageable.getPageSize()). Alternatively, update the TaskService interface to accept a Pageable parameter instead of separate int parameters.
